issues.detail: The Hebrew has 'שִׁמְעִי בֶן גֵּרָא' (Shimei son of Gera), but the Chinese renders '希瑪利人革拉的兒子' which introduces '希瑪利人' (Himaelite?) — this appears to be a corruption or misreading of 'שִׁמְעִי' (Shimei) as a gentilic, and the name 'Shimei' is not clearly preserved. The correct rendering should be '示每' or '希每' (Shimei), not '希瑪利人'.
